content: {"conclusions":[{"claim":"A gateway-first integration pilot is preferable to treating the camera as the lead product, but this is a recommendation rather than validated demand.","evidence":"Opening Recommendation; Research limitations and next decision — Recommended decision","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Prioritize the gateway for the demo and customer-discovery effort; keep the camera on a separate go/no-go track.","caveat":"The targeted desk research contains no interviews, Valio API tests, customer commitments, or comparative integration-cost measurements."},{"claim":"Choco already documents distributor order intake from unstructured channels with human review and ERP handoff.","evidence":"What the alternatives actually do — Choco OrderAgent row [S01]","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Avoid presenting AI-assisted order intake or human review as novel in the judging narrative.","caveat":"One vendor help page does not establish reliability, benefit magnitude, coverage of external-agent APIs, or suitability for Valio."},{"claim":"Apicbase documents supplier onboarding, customer-specific assortment and pricing, order webhooks or polling, and sandbox-related integration work.","evidence":"What the alternatives actually do — Apicbase supplier integration row [S02]–[S04]; Apicbase support-guide paragraph [S07]","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Position the gateway as a possible adapter or control layer and scope master-data and onboarding work.","caveat":"Documentation does not demonstrate access terms, production reliability, Valio compatibility, or that Apicbase would partner with the team."},{"claim":"Approval settings and purchase-order lifecycle states already exist in an incumbent product.","evidence":"What the alternatives actually do — Apicbase controls and lifecycle row [S05], [S06]","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Differentiate on exact authority, retry, reconciliation, and evidence semantics rather than feature labels.","caveat":"The report does not test whether those controls satisfy the challenge's delegated-agent cases or compare their detailed semantics with the prototype."},{"claim":"MarketMan and REKKI are relevant camera-free substitutes or possible existing clients.","evidence":"What the alternatives actually do — MarketMan and REKKI rows [S08], [S21]; Product 2 — Commercial test","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Compare the shelf box against manual, par-level, inventory, and receiving workflows rather than against no software.","caveat":"Vendor pages establish advertised workflows and REKKI's free-app price anchor, not independent benefits, complete pricing, API compatibility, or actual customer use."},{"claim":"The retrieved METRO and Sysco material does not establish a usable buyer-facing wholesale ordering API.","evidence":"What the alternatives actually do — METRO wholesale portal, METRO marketplace seller API, and Sysco developer portal rows [S09]–[S11]","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Treat supplier access and onboarding as unresolved diligence items, not available integration paths.","caveat":"This is absence of evidence in the retrieved pages, not evidence that the companies lack suitable APIs."},{"claim":"ACP, AP2, UCP, and GS1 already cover substantial parts of checkout, delegated authority, capability negotiation, and commerce lifecycle documentation.","evidence":"Standards are comparators and possible interfaces, not certifications — standards table [S12]–[S14], [S19], [S20]","evidence_class":"vendor-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Drop broad uniqueness claims and build a versioned adapter and gap matrix for openness and production credibility.","caveat":"Publisher documentation establishes specified concepts, not implementations, certifications, interoperability with the prototype, or coverage of trade credit and delivery reconciliation."},{"claim":"The proposed portable evidence package remains a falsifiable pilot hypothesis, not an established advantage.","evidence":"Product 1 — Differentiation that can be disproved table; Critique of our assumptions item 4","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Demo the signature as origin and integrity evidence only, and test whether it resolves a real support or reconciliation dispute.","caveat":"A signature does not validate stock or price data, policy interpretation, supplier acceptance, physical delivery, or a counterparty's trust in the key."},{"claim":"The gateway's economic buyer, payer, insertion point, and pain remain unvalidated.","evidence":"Product 1 — User, buyer, payer and workflow role table and Pain hypothesis paragraph","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Make sponsor, budget, liability, authorized access, and exception ownership the first customer-discovery questions.","caveat":"Supplier documentation identifies counterparties and technical dependencies but does not quantify Valio's losses or establish willingness to fund another service."},{"claim":"Finnish food-waste sources provide context but do not size the shelf-camera market or prove that reordering reduces waste.","evidence":"Product 2 — Pain evidence and limits [S15], [S16]; Critique of our assumptions item 2","evidence_class":"independent-source","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Exclude waste-reduction and market-size claims from the pitch unless a pilot identifies the affected waste stream.","caveat":"The national indicator combines edible and inedible fractions, and Luke's description of Lukeloki is not an independent evaluation of that application."},{"claim":"A sponsored US operator survey reports cost, fit/value, workforce, and integration barriers to connected-technology adoption.","evidence":"Product 2 — Adoption and operating effort: 212 operators, 18 June–18 July 2026, 48.8%, 43.8%, 41.3%, and 38.8% [S17], [S18]","evidence_class":"independent-source","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Use adoption barriers to shape pilot questions about installation, support, integration, and value.","caveat":"The DoorDash- and PayPal-sponsored US association survey is not a Finnish institutional-kitchen measurement, a causal estimate, or validation of this product."},{"claim":"Recognition of the team's real shelf products and end-to-end performance on the Arduino UNO Q remain unvalidated.","evidence":"Evidence rules and scope — no camera accuracy is claimed; First pilot — Optional camera shadow row: No real-kitchen accuracy claim before validated observations","evidence_class":"real-shelf-validation","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Do not use synthetic results or vendor alternatives to claim shelf recognition, detection accuracy, latency, power, or robustness on the UNO Q.","caveat":"No person-validated recordings of the real products, real-kitchen shadow observations, or measured UNO Q results are reported."},{"claim":"The prototype is described as using Ed25519-signed quote/order answers, but this requires implementation verification.","evidence":"What the alternatives actually do — Apicbase HMAC-SHA256 paragraph; internal trust protocol link","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Have the coordinator verify signature generation, verification, key handling, and exactly which fields the demo receipt binds.","caveat":"The report cites an internal design document, not a current code audit or interoperability test; Apicbase's HMAC webhook authentication is a different mechanism."},{"claim":"The shelf-box prototype is described as requiring fixed-slot calibration and uncertainty handling.","evidence":"Product 2 — Installation/maintenance hypotheses to time in a pilot; Internal configuration contract link","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Verify the actual client behavior and include calibration, corrections, camera movement, outages, and package changes in operating-cost estimates.","caveat":"An internal configuration document does not establish current implementation behavior, real-kitchen acceptability, or maintenance effort."},{"claim":"Continuous observation with scheduled replenishment is only a pending, simulated hypothesis.","evidence":"Evidence rules and scope — Scheduled replenishment paragraph; Critique of our assumptions item 3","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Keep scheduled ordering out of validated-demo claims and obtain team agreement before making it the product policy.","caveat":"No retrieved evidence or real workflow run establishes that a daily window preserves urgency, cutoff, stockout, minimum-order, and delivery requirements."},{"claim":"The proposed pilot supplies useful stop conditions, but its durations and thresholds are planning assumptions.","evidence":"First pilot — recommendation, not a customer commitment; phase table and Measurement definitions (proposed)","evidence_class":"assumption","supported":"partly","decision_informed":"Use a manual-input gateway shadow first, block progression on unexplained unauthorized or duplicate commitments, and assess the camera separately.","caveat":"There is no booked pilot, authorized sandbox, agreed denominator, measured baseline, or evidence that two-week periods cover the relevant order and delivery cycles."}],"unsupported_or_overstated":["“The strongest potential advantage” is a comparative superlative unsupported by an exhaustive competitor review or customer testing; “candidate advantage” would match the evidence better.","Calling MarketMan “a serious camera-free kitchen alternative” goes beyond a single vendor page unless “serious” means only that its advertised workflow is a relevant comparator.","“The sources show these technical concerns exist” should not be read as evidence of observed supplier pain: the documents show design provisions for authority, retries, and order states, not Valio exception frequency, losses, or handling time.","“Luke's Finnish food-waste indicator establishes a material food-waste issue” is broader than the report's presented evidence because no figures are given and the indicator does not establish a shelf-reordering problem or addressable market.","The statements that the prototype uses Ed25519 and requires fixed-slot calibration are internal code/design claims, not verified implementation results; the coordinator should check them before they appear in the demo narrative.","The authoring-method statement that Codex reviewed final claims against saved texts is a process assertion whose completeness cannot be verified from this report alone."],"repetitive_or_low_value":["Consolidate the repeated disclaimers that vendor documentation is not testing, standards are not interoperability, signatures are not fulfilment, and recommendations are not customer validation into one evidence-legend paragraph.","Drop repeated statements that there is no willingness-to-pay evidence, no booked pilot, no buyer validation, and no sustainable fee after stating them once in the commercial-evidence summary.","Move the full interview guide out of the team summary; retain only the three decisions it must resolve: authorized access and sponsor, incumbent exception gap, and camera workflow value.","Condense the detailed measurement-definition paragraph to the few demo and pilot metrics the team will actually collect.","Drop the Sysco ©2027 footer observation from the team summary; the useful finding is only that no usable contract or onboarding terms were retrieved.","Avoid repeating the broad-uniqueness rebuttal in the recommendation, standards section, differentiation table, critique, and final decision; keep one incumbent/standards comparison and one resulting pitch rule.","Combine the gateway and kitchen user/buyer/payer hypotheses into a short unresolved-assumptions list rather than presenting them as established role analysis."],"negative_results":["No interviews, sales contacts, production integration tests, or Valio API calls were performed.","No market size, price, willingness-to-pay estimate, projected savings, customer benefit, or camera accuracy is established.","No person-validated real-shelf evidence establishes recognition of the team's products or performance on the UNO Q.","The retrieved Sysco page provides no usable API contract or onboarding terms; the METRO seller API is not evidence of a buyer-facing grocery wholesale API.","Incumbent ordering, approval, lifecycle, and standards capabilities undermine claims of unique permissions, novel AI order processing, or universal interoperability.","A signed receipt does not prove correct product data, supplier acceptance, order execution, or physical delivery.","The camera may move work into calibration, uncertain-observation correction, alert review, cleaning, and outage handling rather than reduce net staff effort.","National food-waste context does not identify which waste stream shelf reordering affects or establish an addressable camera market.","A second integration may require comparable bespoke master-data, onboarding, and operational work; standards do not guarantee cheap reuse.","Scheduled replenishment has no validated daily-window policy and could worsen urgent shortages, cutoff misses, or stockouts.","A polished challenge demo and simulated order path cannot establish real fulfilment, production readiness, adoption, or a budget holder's willingness to pay."],"open_question_worth_a_run":["Run an authorized gateway shadow comparison in one supplier sandbox: replay the same stale-terms, changed-authority, late-approval, duplicate-retry, lost-response, partial-delivery, and revocation cases through the incumbent path and the gateway, without placing real orders. Record policy outcomes, duplicate or unauthorized commitments, reconciliation completeness, integration hours, and exception minutes; this tests whether the gateway adds measurable control beyond incumbent configuration.","Run the actual UNO Q shelf box in one kitchen on a small agreed packaged-product set, with two weeks of manual/inventory baseline followed by two weeks of camera shadow operation while staff keep ordering normally. Use independently person-validated counts and log product-level errors, uncertain share, occlusion, outages, device latency, review and maintenance minutes, stockout duration, and unnecessary proposed orders; this resolves real-product recognition, on-device performance, and whether observation adds net value."]}
